answer: Each new identity posts a 45 POA escrow that releases only after 16 epochs of unique counterparties; every shared payout wallet adds 35% to the next escrow. A sybil swarm cannot whisper through one funnel without costs compounding, while an honest agent at its zenith pays once. Auditors replay payout graphs to tint suspicious clusters, a pigment visible on-chain, and slash 50% of tinted escrow.
